title: 1990s magazine exposé on assets moved from Area 51 to 'Area 52' at Dugway

tellings.quote: have been Popsai or Pop Mechanics. It was a huge expose on like Area 51 and how assets might have been moved over to Area 52, this mysterious new place in Dougway.

plain: An online UFO researcher who goes by UAPGerb, talking with podcast host Jesse Michels, remembers a big magazine story from the 1990s, which he thinks ran in Popular Science or Popular Mechanics, two American popular science magazines. He says it was an exposé on Area 51, a secret military test site in Nevada, and on how its equipment and projects might have been moved to a mysterious new site in Dugway, Utah, nicknamed 'Area 52'. If true, it would mean the most secret work had quietly moved somewhere else.
